tool.name: Dccm
tool.description: : Dynamical correlation / covariance matrices from MD trajectories.

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Path to the MD trajectory file (e.g. XTC, DCD).. Format: [input].

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Path to the topology file (e.g. PDB).. Format: [input].

param.name: outname_output_matrix_path
param.label: output name
param.help: Path to save the matrix as a NumPy .npz archive (key: dccm). Format: [output].

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: dynamics_type
param.label: dynamics_type
param.help: Use Cartesian displacements or backbone dihedrals.

param.name: stride_step
param.label: stride_step
param.help: Frame stride for parsing the trajectory.

param.name: restart
param.label: restart
param.help: Skip execution if output already exists.
